randomspawnplus.screen.title: RandomSpawnPlus settings
randomspawnplus.screen.info: Save to apply. Separate list entries with commas.
randomspawnplus.setting.border_margin.de: In blocks: minimum distance from the world border edge
randomspawnplus.setting.spawn_spread_rad: In blocks: random spawn zone around the world spawn
Attempts to find a safe spot before falling back
randomspawnplus.setting.safe_spot_search: Blocks: radius scanned around a picked point
randomspawnplus.setting.height_above_gro: How many blocks above the ground the player is placed
randomspawnplus.setting.worlds.desc: Worlds to randomize spawns in (empty = all)
randomspawnplus.setting.first_join_enabl: Choose a random spawn when a player joins for the first time
randomspawnplus.setting.first_join_min_r: Minimum distance from the world spawn for a first join, in blocks
randomspawnplus.setting.first_join_max_r: Maximum distance from the world spawn for a first join, in blocks
Choose a random spawn after a player's death
randomspawnplus.setting.respawn_min_radi: Minimum distance from the world spawn after death, in blocks
randomspawnplus.setting.respawn_max_radi: Maximum distance from the world spawn after death, in blocks
randomspawnplus.setting.performance_prof: Sets the per-tick and per-search work limits
randomspawnplus.setting.player_spacing.d: Minimum distance from other players, in blocks (0 disables spacing)
randomspawnplus.setting.lava_safety_radi: Avoid surface lava within this many blocks (0 disables the check; maximum 16)
randomspawnplus.setting.avoid_trees.desc: Reject spawn points on tree blocks
randomspawnplus.setting.avoid_narrow_led: Reject narrow surfaces without enough room around the player
Biome IDs to exclude, separated by commas (for example minecraft:deep_ocean)
randomspawnplus.setting.reserve_points.d: Number of safe spawn points to prepare ahead (0 disables the reserve; maximum 32)
randomspawnplus.setting.verbose.desc: Write a detailed console log of the spawn search (for debugging)
randomspawnplus.error.invalid_number: Field "%s" must be a non-negative integer
